controls.label: Unknown page identity remains explicit across every exit
controls.intent: Unsplit whole-document text must set pageIdentityKnown=false, keep every page field null/absent, and declare that the supporting document is known but the exact page is unavailable — never report this as missing provenance entirely.

controls.label: No helper may default a finding to page 1
controls.intent: Helpers that previously fell back to pageNumber=1 / 'p.1' / 'page 1' / 'p.null' must refuse synthetic page references when page identity is unknown.

controls.label: Source and compiled page numbering stay distinct
controls.intent: Genuine page units preserve exact source-document and compiled-bundle page numbers side by side. Numbering must not shift or collapse one into the other.

controls.label: Operative precedence follows documentary truth tiers
controls.intent: Precedence order is: explicit replacement → reliable operative status → document version/date → chronological upload order → stable id tie-break. Array/retrieval order never selects the operative instrument alone.

controls.label: Upload order is only the final documentary fallback
controls.intent: uploadOrder may break ties after documentary signals are exhausted, but it is never a substitute for explicit replacement, status, date or version.

controls.label: Equal or absent timestamps stay deterministic
controls.intent: Equal updated_at values, null timestamps and invalid timestamps must produce identical operative results across reruns via a stable id tie-break — never array position.

controls.label: No silent supersession or charge cloning
controls.intent: A later-uploaded duplicate without supported relationship must not silently supersede an earlier instrument. Earlier wording remains visible as superseded (when supported) and is never cloned from the operative wording.
